_comment: Real event photos shown on booth pages in an 'At real events' section. Key = booth slug (see data/booths.json). Each entry: image = base name of a processed image in /images (listed in data/images.json; create them with scripts/add-event-photo.py), alt = what the photo shows, caption = optional short text. Leave a booth's list empty to hide the section. Only use photos the client has supplied; captions describe the booth and setting, never a named venue or customer unless confirmed.
